rules.name: PAN & Bank KYC Harvesting
rules.description: Solicits urgent PAN or KYC submission over message.
rules.simpleReason: Asks for PAN card or KYC via text message, which banks never do.

rules.name: Account & Card Suspension Threat
rules.description: Threatens immediate account or card suspension to induce panic.
rules.simpleReason: Threatens account or card blocking to force hasty compliance.

rules.name: Secret OTP & PIN Solicitation
rules.description: Directly solicits one-time passwords, MPIN, CVV, or passwords.
rules.simpleReason: Asks for secret OTP or banking PIN passwords.

rules.name: India Post / Courier Delivery Failure
rules.description: Bait claiming an undeliverable package requiring address update.
rules.simpleReason: Fake delivery notification urging you to update address via link.

rules.name: Electricity / Utility Cutoff Extortion
rules.description: Threatens same-day power disconnection to force instant payment or phone calls.
rules.simpleReason: Threatens power disconnection unless you call or pay immediately.

rules.name: Digital Arrest / Legal Coercion
rules.description: Fabricates law enforcement or judicial warrants to coerce payment.
rules.simpleReason: Threatens police arrest or court summons to terrify victims.

rules.name: Remote Access Tool Abuse
rules.description: Directs victim to download screen-sharing tools or rogue APKs.
rules.simpleReason: Asks to download remote-control apps that grant phone takeover.

rules.name: Artificial Rush Deadline
rules.description: Imposes short countdown deadline to bypass critical thinking.
rules.simpleReason: Uses strict time deadlines to panic the recipient.

advisories.title: Widespread Distribution of Fraudulent APK Files Mimicking PM Welfare Schemes
advisories.summary: Attackers are distributing malicious Android APK packages via WhatsApp claiming to register citizens for Pradhan Mantri financial welfare schemes. Once installed, the APK requests SMS read permissions to siphon OTPs.

advisories.title: Surge in "Digital Arrest" Cyber Extortion Calls Impersonating Law Enforcement
advisories.summary: The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre issued an urgent citizen warning regarding syndicates posing as CBI, Customs, and State Police officers on video calls, placing citizens under fake "Digital Arrest" and extorting funds.

advisories.title: Advisory on Fraudulent Mobile Applications and Screen-Sharing App Abuse
advisories.summary: RBI reiterated safety warnings against installing remote-access screen sharing apps (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) at the behest of callers posing as bank or utility executives.

advisories.title: Transnational Operation "First Light" Dismantles Southeast Asian Boiler Rooms
advisories.summary: INTERPOL coordination across 61 countries intercepted $257 Million in illicit funds and froze 6,745 bank accounts connected to industrial-scale investment and romance scam compounds.
